frozen_input_probe.scope: Frozen world after walking, no steps; public force API with identical float64 inputs; full control mode/force/position/velocity arrays compared including untouched arm DOFs. Synchronized microbenchmark is not full-loop latency.

installed_write_probe.scope: Frozen world after walking, no steps; public force API with identical float64 inputs; full control mode/force/position/velocity arrays compared including untouched arm DOFs. Synchronized microbenchmark is not full-loop latency.

dds_motor.scope: Real two-process CycloneDDS, real SimEndpoint and full SimRuntime command consumer, real Genesis setter/getter; interrupt immediately before physics for same-instant actuator comparison. Not WAN/SROS2 or hardware.

initial_probe_failure.reason: Bit-exact untouched-base Euler coordinates were too strict for Genesis FK float32 normalization: max2.4959445e-7 rad; retry allows1e-6rad for base RPY only, keeping leg DOFs and untouched velocities exact. Runtime unchanged.

limitations: Short synthetic walks do not prove long-duration or physical hardware behavior.
These clean core-loop timings exclude actual UI/DDS/WAN overhead; DDS motor delivery was checked separately.
Loopback media receivers share the compute host resources; clock/CPU/GPU contention changes wall time.
Frozen write timings exclude physics and the optimizer and are not full step latency.
Detailed nested timers add overhead and inclusive child/parent times must not be added together.
Full Sim+quality has one existing RL waypoint/limit failure; full required/extended/release gate was not rerun.

The first optimized candidate walk had a different but valid trajectory; later optimized and legacy runs matched exactly. Do not infer exact determinism across all runs; cause of the first-run difference was not established.
Same-image paired means improved, but p95 overlapped and separate before/after image means changed less than the paired comparison.
